blogs.title: When One Shot Isn't Enough: Navigating the Uncertainty of Biphasic vs. Multiphasic Anaphylaxis
blogs.description: This post explores the diagnostic nuance between biphasic and multiphasic anaphylaxis using the case of a patient experiencing four distinct recurrences. It challenges readers to distinguish 'true' biphasic reactions from sustained anaphylaxis or ongoing antigen absorption, discussing why current definitions remain fluid and proposing a framework for recognizing patterns that suggest a higher-order, multiphasic course.

blogs.title: Underdosed in Disguise? Re-evaluining Epinephrine Auto-Injector Dosage in Adult Obesity
blogs.description: Focusing on the critical pharmacological gap highlighted in the case, this article analyzes the discrepancy between international guidelines recommending 0.5 mg epinephrine and the widespread prevalence of 0.3 mg auto-injectors. We will examine whether standardizing adult auto-doses to 0.5 mg immediately reduces the need for rescue interventions and delays in achieving hemodynamic stability, particularly in heavier patients.
